nodes.label: Canvas Design System
nodes.rationale: Reference doc defining visual design philosophy, two-phase process, core principles, design movements, implementation guidelines, and output format.

nodes.label: Design Philosophy Creation
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 of the two-phase process: create an aesthetic movement expressed through form, space, color, composition, not layouts or templates.

nodes.label: Visual Expression
nodes.rationale: Phase 2: express philosophy through canvas artifacts at 90% visual / 10% essential text, museum-quality execution.

nodes.label: Visual Communication First
nodes.rationale: Core principle: information lives in design, not paragraphs; expressed via color zones, geometric precision, spatial relationships, visual weight.

nodes.label: Minimal Text Integration
nodes.rationale: Core principle: text as rare powerful gesture, never paragraphs, typography as visual element, small labels huge impact.

nodes.label: Expert Craftsmanship
nodes.rationale: Core principle: work appears meticulously crafted, master-level execution, product of countless hours.

nodes.label: Systematic Patterns
nodes.rationale: Core principle: scientific visual language of repeating patterns, perfect shapes, dense accumulation, layered elements.

nodes.label: Chromatic Language
nodes.rationale: Design movement: color as primary information system, geometric precision, Josef Albers interaction meets data visualization.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Approach
nodes.rationale: Implementation color approach: limited 2-5 color palette, cohesive system, oklch color space for precision, each shade carries meaning.

nodes.label: Multi-Page Design Systems
nodes.rationale: Multi-page approach: shared color palette, consistent typography, related composition, visual language continuity, philosophical thread.

nodes.label: Execution Checklist
nodes.rationale: Quality gate: 90% visual / 10% text max, nothing overlaps, pristine margins, museum-quality master-level execution.
